notes.title: Steam Deck Fix
notes.content: [p]Dear Steam Deck players,[/p][p]Thank you for your patience. We have been working to address the issue where the game wouldn’t launch on Steam Deck. While we work on the next patch, a fix has been pushed to the public beta so that you can continue playing.[/p][p]To access the beta, select “Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition” from your Library, access Properties, scroll down to Betas and in Beta Participation select “beta – Public Beta Branch“ from the dropdown. You might need to restart your device for the update to happen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629878/5c99dd93d0eee2a4ce78cf6d520e4a52d4439205.png"][/img][/p][p]For the Emperor![/p]

notes.title: Patch 5 notes
notes.content: [p]A new month, a new patch. [/p][p]This update comes with lots of new fixes and additions, but this time around we have decided to focus on UI. Thanks again for your patience. [/p][p]Courage and honour! [/p][p][b]🖥️ User Interface[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Added an interactive progress widget for the “Hold to Collect Servo Skull” action. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Subtitles now appear in prerendered videos and subtitle timing has been improved. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon radial menu now greys out unusable weapons. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Network lag indicator added. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Password prompt scaling issues resolved. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tooltip visibility restored across various menus. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Chapter checkpoint descriptions now appear as tooltips. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Audio Log screen redesigned to reflect the original game, with past voice lines now visible. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DPad icons updated with new button glyphs for clearer navigation. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon ammo values now padded (e.g., 09/10). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Terms of Service dialog and account unlinking button added to Options menu. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Opacity reduced for unavailable player spawn options. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tutorial screen requests now ignored during fades or cinematics. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added SFX on several menus. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed various chat-related issues. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]🗺️ Other[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed softlock issue in the Terms of Service screen. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed out-of-bounds death fall in Chapter 7. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck verified ✅
notes.content: [p]Good news if you are a Steam Deck player! We have been working on some UI fixes to improve accessibility and the game is now Steam Deck-verified. [/p][p]We are one in the Emperor! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629878/f2fb24fd59f0e3ca0cc506bc79ebc381be77cf2d.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Partch 4 notes
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! [/p][p]We are back with another update. Patch 4 comes packed with fixes and improvements. Hope you continue enjoying the game and, once again, thank you for your patience. [/p][p]For the Emperor! [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Multiplayer[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed multiplayer crash. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated Switch Team button behaviour and positioning in matchmaking/private lobbies. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved EOS session handling and login flow; added toggle for EOS overlay. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay [/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed an infinite input loop when cursor position didn’t change. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect weapon info for Dreadnought Autocannon. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed Steam Deck soft lock-up issue. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI Improvements[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Added keybind info popup in Customizer. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Adjusted unlock event notifications based on game mode (campaign vs multiplayer). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed heat indicator visual bug and string corruption in unlock events. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved accessibility for Steam Deck. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]UI scaling and layout tweaks: auto-width for action buttons, arrow indicators for navigation, and multiplayer lobby card adjustments. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Minor UI fixes. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Localisation[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Minor localisation fixes. [/p][/*][/list]

[p][b]🛠️ Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition – Refunds, Discounts & Patch Plans [/b][/p][p]Hi everyone, 
 
We’ve got some important updates to share for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine: Master Crafted Edition, including an extended refund policy, details on a 50% upgrade path discount, and a preview of the patch improvements coming soon. [/p][p][b]💸 Refunds & Upgrade Discount – What You Need to Know [/b][/p][p]We’ve heard your concerns around pricing, and we want to be clear about the steps we’re taking to address them. [/p][p][b]🟦 Extended Refund Window – Until July 10 [/b][/p][p]If you’ve already purchased Space Marine: Master Crafted Edition, you are eligible for a full refund, regardless of playtime, as long as you request it before 6pm BST/10pm PST July 10 2025 (when the Steam Summer Sale ends). [/p][p][u][url="https://help.steampowered.com/"]🔗 Request Your Refund via Steam Support[/url][/u] [/p][p][b]🟨 50% Upgrade Discount [/b][/p][p]• If you own Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Anniversary Edition, you’re eligible for a 50% discount when buying the Master Crafted Edition from 6pm BST/10pm PST June 26 2025 until 6pm BST/10pm PST July 10 2025 when the discount offer ends. 
• New buyers who already own the original game will see the discount automatically applied at checkout. 
• If you already purchased the Master Crafted Edition and qualify for the discount, you’ll need to:

notes.title: Warhammer 40000: Space Marine – Master Crafted Edition (PC) Review
notes.content:
As someone who likes the idea of Warhammer 40000 but lacks the time, skill, space, and budget to engage with the hobby, I deeply enjoyed the original Space Marine back on the PlayStation 3. It allowed me to “get my fix” and dip into that universe without clearing out my dining room or bank account. After all, not many online shooters can tempt me to spend enough time in their multiplayer modes to max out my level, but the PvP mode was genuinely fun.

Over the years, I’ve often stared at the PC version, trying to justify it on many Steam sales, especially since the Anniversary Edition dropped in 2021 to include all the DLC. This amplified again when Warhammer 40000: Space Marine 2 was announced and hype built around it, yet still, I held off.

So now that Warhammer 40000: Space Marine—Master Crafted Edition is here, I should be ecstatic, right?

On paper, a next-gen upgrade for Relic Entertainment’s 14-year-old classic sounds great. The Master Crafted... Read more
